name: aveniqmvc
description: Aveniq ASP.NET Core MVC site. package.json added to enable full import by some hosting providers.

scripts.build: sh -c "if command -v dotnet >/dev/null 2>&1; then dotnet publish AveniqMvc.csproj -c Release -o ./publish; else npm run build:static; fi"
scripts.build:static: sh -c "mkdir -p ./publish && cp -r wwwroot/* ./publish/ || true && echo 'Static export: server-side views not included. Deploy the published folder for a static site.' > ./publish/README.txt"
